 "rationale": "The NMOS pair suits VCM ~0.9 V with pfet Vth ~1 V. Long-L pair and long-L sinks give two ~37 dB stages, so A0 is ~75 dB. GBW is gm1/Cc ~30 MHz. The second stage carries ~140 uA so that gm7 >> 2.2*gm1*CL/Cc, which sets PM; Rz cancels the RHP zero. Total current is ~180 uA, about 360 uW at 1.98 V. The PMOS CS output swings rail-to-rail minus ~0.3 V. The tail at 24 uA gives SR ~24 V/us. A large-area input pair keeps 1/f noise low."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L_in":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),
    "I_tail":  (24e-6, 16e-6, 50e-6),
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L_p":     (0.7, 0.4, 1.2),
    "gmid_n":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "L_n":     (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),
    "I2":      (140e-6, 80e-6, 200e-6),
    "Cc":      (1.0e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "kz":      (1.6, 0.8, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I2, Cc = p["I_tail"], p["I2"], p["Cc"]
    Id1 = It / 2

    # input pair (NMOS), vds ~ 0.6 (vy ~0.75, source ~0.25)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Id1, vds=0.5)
    # PMOS mirror load; M7 shares gm/Id and L -> equal Vsg, no systematic offset
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Id1, vds=m1.vgs if False else 1.0)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I2, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirror family: ref diode, tail, 2nd-stage sink (same gm/Id and L)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], It, vds=0.25)
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I2, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M8", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> vinp non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.R("Rz", "y", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m6.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 1e-15
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    pmirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz)) if abs(1.0 / m7.gm - Rz) > 1e-9 else 1e15
    ph = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmirror))
    ph += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z))) * (1 if z < 0 else -1)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I2 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    gn = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) * 2 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(gn) * 4.0  # crude allowance for 1/f at 1 kHz
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 / m5.gds * a1 / max(a1, 1) * (m3.gm / m1.gm)) if m5.gds > 0 else 60
    psrr = db(a1 * a2) - 30
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": ph, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr}
